name: Split Product Slider
description: Full-screen split product slider with a spec panel and prev/next controls on one side and layered photos on a colored panel on the other, switching scenes with slide and wipe transitions.
contents: Left panel with brand label, counter, scene title, product image and spec grid
Right panel with colored backdrop, two overlapping photos and maker name with tag
behavior: Next and previous buttons or arrow keys change the scene, wrapping around
Panels slide in and out while photos cross-fade and a color cover wipes across them
Input is locked during the transition
Stacks vertically on mobile with the photos on top
editableByProps: Scenes, all text, specs, images and maker details
Panel colors per scene, background and text color classes
Transition duration, button labels and fonts

needsCodeEdit.where: coverRefs divs with bg-black and bg-white
order-1 and order-2 classes on the two main panels

fixed: Fills the full viewport height (100dvh) and is meant to be used as a full-screen section
Listens to ArrowLeft and ArrowRight on the window while mounted and removes the listeners on unmount
Loads the heading and body fonts from Google Fonts
